comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
7-item Album related to Transmutation Alchemy recipes unlocked by (future) "Star Wisdom: Celestial Device"(g.t.) Legacy Theme. Like the Calculator and Aroma legacies, specific discoveries unlock each item's recipe. Items:

Astronomer's Robe (6:00/bottom discovery)
Shooting Star Necklace (2:00/upper right discovery)
Ancient Star Atlas (4:00/lower right discovery)
Special Golden Wooden Paneling (8:00/lower left discovery)
Special Golden Metal Paneling (10:00/upper left discovery)
Double Stars (12:00/top discovery)
Sailors' Star Charm (0:00/center discovery)

MA Reward: Observational Astrolabe
NPC: Sinan Pasha(Tripoli)

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1299.html
Legacy Guide: tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO (Star Legacy can be found in the 8th Legacy tab, farthest to the right)
